Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The two best Mutant Super Heroes have returned

to the world of MARVEL Future Fight as a duo to save the world in crisis!

 

We introduce the July Update in celebration of

the release of Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine.

 

New Uniforms have been added to the two heroes created through the Weapon X Program,

Wolverine, owner of powerful adamantium claws,

and Deadpool, a talkative mercenary who never stops telling jokes.

 

Especially, Deadpool, who received a Tier-4 Advancement

has become even more powerful and is ready to break the fourth wall.

 

In addition, Cassandra Nova has joined MARVEL Future Fight as a new Super Villain

to use the power of Tier-3 to destroy the coexistence of humans and Mutants!

 

Moreover, various improvements such as decreased playtime, increased team saving slots,

and improved rewards have been made in Alliance Conquest, where many heroes fight together.

 

Lastly, the convenience features of Multiverse Saga and Emblem Collection

have been improved so Agents can enjoy the game even more.

 

Please check below for more details!

 

▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Cassandra Nova <Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine>,

who is Charles Xavier's twin and inherently evil.

* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms

 

Three new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine have been added.

Check out the abilities of Deadpool <Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine>,

Handsomepool <Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine>,

and Wolverine <Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine>.

 

* The new Uniform skill effects are based on Lv.10 stats.

* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <July Update Celebration Event>, 

and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

 

[About the Deadpool Uniform]

Deadpool <Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine> and

Handsomepool <Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine> are Synergy Uniforms.

Synergy Sales will also be applied during the <July Update Celebration Event>.

 

 

 

 

▣ Deadpool Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Deadpool, all of whose actions are unpredictable.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

▣ Cassandra Nova Tier-3

 

Cassandra Nova is trying to use the Tier-3 Ultimate skill

as a means to achieve her purpose and destroy everything.

 

 

 

▣ Negasonic Teenage Warhead, Jubilee, and Dazzler

 Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the July Update, Negasonic Teenage Warhead, Jubilee, and Dazzler

will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Doctor Doom <God Emperor>

Improvements and Uniform Discount

 

Doctor Doom <God Emperor> has been improved and will be on sale at a discounted price.

 

1. The order of skills used during the Auto Play has been changed.

 

2. Improvements have been made in the certain skill.

 

3. A 40% discount applies to the Doctor Doom <God Emperor> and the 5 Uniform Options

after the 7/23 Maintenance is completed.

- Event Schedule:

After the 7/23 Maintenance - 7/30 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),

After the 7/23 Maintenance - 7/30 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

- Please check the list of Uniform Options in-game.

 

 

▣ Alliance Conquest Improvements

 

Alliance Conquest, a battle content that all heroes and Alliance members

can participate in together, has been improved.

 

1. The overall playtime of Alliance Conquest has been decreased.

It has become advantageous to occupy the area as quickly as possible.

 

[Decreased Playtime]

The overall duration of the Alliance Conquest has been reduced from 4 days to 3 days.

Battle Phase time has been reduced from 2 hours to 1 hour.

 

[Conquest Point / Seal Effect Deleted ]

Bonus points can be acquired in conquered areas according to the conquering time.

1 bonus point can be earned for every 5 minutes in each area.

* Bonus points you already acquired are maintained even if you lost the conquest area.

* Points cannot be earned in the Starting area and Dispatch area.

 

 

The existing Seal Effect has been deleted

and the protection effect that prevents other Alliances from attacking for a certain period

when successfully conquering the area has been added.

Now it is advantageous to conquer many areas as quickly as possible and defend them.

* Certain Special & Dispatch Abilities have changed due to changes

in conquer time and Seal Effects. Please check the details in-game.

 

 

2. Defeated heroes can be restored at once on a team basis in the

[Set Characters] - [Set Characters for Alliance Conquest] - [Manage Alliance Conquest Team] screen 

at the Prep Phase.

- The feature that restores one hero at a time in the existing hero management screen will be maintained.

* Heroes cannot be changed or excluded in the Manage Alliance Conquest Team screen.

 

 

3. The rules that apply to the winner when switching between the rounds have been changed.

- Current HP, Passive buffs, Passive Skill Cooldown, and Artifact Cooldown will not reset.

- The Passive Skills with the “Always Active” effect that activates again after the Cooldown

when the effect is canceled will not reset when switching rounds.

 

4. The Code Name of the Agent who successfully attacked the defenders

while the area has not been conquered is displayed in the Defense Info.

 

 

5. The number of Defense Success for each defender is displayed on the Defense Info screen.

 

 

6. Available slots in the Save Conquest Team have been increased from 10 to 30.

 

 

7. The Alliance Conquest reward has been improved.

- The amount of Gold that can be acquired as a Ranking Reward has been increased.

- Emblem Data and Tier-4 growth materials can be obtained 

depending on the grade of the Contribution Reward Chest.

(e.g. Challenger League Reward - ‘Contribution Reward Chest: Mythic’)

 

 

* Please check the detailed reward list in-game.

- Alliance Tokens have been added as a participation reward.

The number of Alliance Tokens that can be acquired increases

depending on the number of participation.

* The participation reward resets every 24 hours based on the start time of the Alliance Conquest.

 

 

▣ Multiverse Saga & Emblem Collection Improvements

 

▶ Multiverse Saga

The convenience feature and the balance have been improved

and the Crystal purchase product has been added.

 

1. Crystal purchase has been added to the Multiverse Saga: Day of Dooms Plus Pack.

 

 

2. The skill cooldown decrease value applied to each battle episode has been adjusted.

- Before: Decreases Skill Cooldown by 20%.

- After: Decreases Skill Cooldown by 40%.

 

 

3. The remaining entry count display to the boss stages has been added

to the Boss & Hidden Boss button on the main screen of Multiverse Saga.

 

 

4. A notice stating that Emblems you already own will be converted to Emblem Data

in Multiverse Saga Story Episode has been added.

 

5. The Special Skill Patterns of Boss and Hidden Boss have been changed.

 

6. The difficulty of the Battle Stages 2-7, 4-1, 4-3, and 6-8 has been lowered.

 

▶ Emblem Collection

The convenience feature of the Emblem Collection has been improved.

 

1. A ‘Location’ button has been added to check the acquisition location of each Emblem.

 

 

2. The level of the Emblems owned can be checked

by tapping each Emblem displayed on the Clear Reward Screen of Multiverse Saga

or Available Emblems list in the [Store] - [Dimension Chest] - [Emblem Chest].

- The level information is displayed as [Unowned] if the corresponding Emblem is not possessed.

 

 

3. [Applied Content] and [Effect] have been added to the search filter in the Emblems menu.

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

1. Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Cassandra Nova,

Negasonic Teenage Warhead, Jubilee, and Dazzler have been added.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

2. The Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Deadpool has been improved.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season

the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.

- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase

when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.

Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards!

Another Special Icon that can be acquired through the upcoming Event

will be revealed later, so please look forward to it.

 

[July Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine.

Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward!

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The display of Team Effects in the [Team] - [My Team] has been improved.

 

- Agents can check the effects applied to allies such as Passive Skills, Uniform effects,

Artifact Exclusive Passive Skill, and Custom Gear effects.

 - When tapping [All Effects], Agents can check the combined effects applied to allies at once.

 - The Team Effect information can also be checked on the battle preparation screen for each content.

 

2. A Favorite feature has been added to the Set Team menu in Otherworld Battle.

- Heroes set as favorites are displayed at the top.

 

 

3. The convenience feature of World Boss has been improved.

 

▶ The [Ability] category has been added to the filter of the World Boss - Choose Allies screen.

- Select [Ability] in the filter to display only heroes with the ability you want.

 

 

▶ The button that can check the list of Requirements for each stage

has been added on the World Boss - Select Difficulty screen.

 

 

 

4. The Uniforms of certain heroes that can be purchased at a discounted price

through Guided Quest have been changed to the latest Uniform.

- Target Hero: 

Loki, Hulk, Black Panther, Rocket Raccoon, Groot, Thor, Doctor Octopus, Spider-Man (Miles Morales)

* If you have already purchased the target hero's Uniform with a 50% discount

by completing the Guided Quest before the update,

the additional discount will not be applied to the updated Uniforms.

* Uniforms already in trial will not be replaced with the latest Uniforms.

 

5. ‘Update Hot Deals’ products have been added.

- Event Schedule:

After the 7/23 Maintenance - 8/20 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),

After the 7/23 Maintenance - 8/20 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

- The following products are available in the ‘Update Hot Deals’ category in the Store.

* The price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

6. The Biometrics purchase screen for the hero whose Biometrics are available at the Support Shop

is directly displayed when selecting the Support Shop button in the location pop-up of the Biometrics.

 

7. The purchase pop-up window remains after purchase

when purchasing heroes’ Biometrics from the Support Shop.

 

8. The product filtering category list has been updated in the search feature of the Store.

 

9. The clear conditions for Story missions of

Epic Quest <Rise of the X-Men> and <X-Force> have been lowered.

 

10. The certain part of the skill description of

Victorious <Emperor Guarder>'s Active 3 (Latverian Revolution) has been changed.

- Before: Increases ATK by +N%

- After: Increases all Basic Attacks by +N%

 

11. ‘Guard Break’ icons have been added in the

Awakened Skill descriptions of Franklin Richards and Valeria Richards.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The tutorial of World Boss stops when progressing through the “?” button in S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy has been fixed.

 

2. The Cooldown Time Decrease ability icon being displayed incorrectly in certain stages of Multiverse Saga Chapter 4-1 where the Cooldown Time decrease had been applied has been fixed.

 

3. The Potential Awakened Skill icon being displayed instead of the Tier-2 Passive Skill on the Hero Tier-2 Advancement Screen has been fixed.

 

4. The remaining period until the upgrade to ‘Tier-4’ is displayed incorrectly as 'Tier-3' in the 20th and 57th-day reward section of the monthly subscription effect pop-up for the ‘Daily Tier-4 Upgrade Support’ product has been fixed.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
